# Forage United States

> A free guide to wild food in the United States: which wild plants are in season in each state and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 41 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Dandelion, Lion's tooth. In season March to October.
- [Chickweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/chickweed/): Stellaria media; Chickweed, Starweed. In season March to November.
- [Lamb's quarters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/plants/lambsquarters/): Chenopodium album; Lamb's quarters, Wild spinach, Goosefoot. In season May to September.

## Dishes

- [Sumac lemonade](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/sumac-lemonade/): Rub sumac clusters in cold water for an hour, strain through a cloth and sweeten. Pink and tart.
- [Elderflower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Steep flower heads overnight with lemon, strain and dissolve in sugar syrup. Dilute with sparkling water.
- [Spruce tip soda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/spruce-tip-soda/): Spruce tip syrup topped with soda water and lime.
- [Prickly pear agua fresca](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/prickly-pear-agua-fresca/): Blend peeled tunas with water and lime, strain out the seeds and serve over ice.
- [Rose hip tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/rose-hip-tea/): Simmer dried hips, strained, with honey.
- [Maple sap tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/maple-sap-tea/): Fresh sap simmered with a tea bag, lightly sweet with no sugar added.
- [Chokecherry syrup soda](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/chokecherry-syrup-soda/): Chokecherry syrup with sparkling water, a Plains favourite.
- [Nettle tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/nettle-tea/): Steep fresh or dried nettle leaves in hot water for 5–10 minutes.
- [Fiddlehead sauté](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/fiddlehead-saut/): Boiled fiddleheads sautéed in butter with garlic and lemon.
- [Pickled ramps](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pickled-ramps/): Ramp bulbs in a hot spiced vinegar brine.
- [Black locust fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/black-locust-fritters/): Flower clusters dipped in light batter, fried and dusted with sugar.
- [Dandelion fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/dandelion-fritters/): Flower heads in batter, fried until golden, with honey.
- [Purslane salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/purslane-salad/): Purslane with tomato, cucumber and lemon.
- [Verdolagas con huevo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/verdolagas-con-huevo/): Purslane scrambled with egg, onion and chilli, Mexican style.
- [Nopales salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/nopales-salad/): Diced, de-spined pads boiled and tossed with tomato, onion, coriander and lime.
- [Roasted pecans](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/roasted-pecans/): Pecans toasted with butter, salt and a little cayenne.
- [Wild garlic mustard pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-garlic-mustard-pesto/): Leaves blended with nuts, cheese, olive oil and lemon.
- [Ramp butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/ramp-butter/): Chopped ramp leaves beaten into softened butter.
- [Cranberry sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/cranberry-sauce/): Cranberries simmered with sugar and orange until they pop.
- [Elderberry syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/elderberry-syrup/): Berries simmered with honey, ginger and cinnamon, strained.
- [Wild grape jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-grape-jelly/): Juiced wild grapes set with sugar.
- [Crabapple jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/crabapple-jelly/): Crab apples simmered, strained and set into a pink jelly.
- [Kinpira gobo](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/kinpira-gobo/): Matchstick burdock root stir-fried with carrot, soy, mirin and sesame.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops simmered with potato and onion, blended with cream.
- [Lamb's quarters spanakopita](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/lamb-s-quarters-spanakopita/): Wild greens with feta in crisp filo.
- [Wild rice soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-rice-soup/): Creamy wild rice and mushroom soup, a Minnesota classic.
- [Crawfish étouffée](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/crawfish-touff-e/): Crawfish tails in a roux of butter, onion, celery and pepper over rice.
- [Camas and salmon bake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/camas-and-salmon-bake/): Slow-baked camas bulbs alongside cedar-planked salmon, after Pacific Northwest tradition.
- [Roasted sunchokes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/roasted-sunchokes/): Sunchokes roasted crisp with olive oil, thyme and salt.
- [Acorn pancakes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/acorn-pancakes/): Leached acorn flour mixed half and half with wheat flour.
- [Mesquite cookies](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/mesquite-cookies/): Sweet mesquite flour shortbread with a caramel taste.
- [Black walnut bread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/black-walnut-bread/): Quick bread studded with black walnuts.
- [Blackberry cobbler](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/blackberry-cobbler/): Blackberries baked under a buttery biscuit topping.
- [Persimmon pudding](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/persimmon-pudding/): Spiced baked pudding of ripe persimmon pulp, a Midwestern and Southern tradition.
- [Pawpaw ice cream](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pawpaw-ice-cream/): Pawpaw pulp churned into custard ice cream.
- [Huckleberry pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/huckleberry-pie/): Mountain huckleberries in a double-crust pie.
- [Serviceberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/serviceberry-crumble/): Serviceberries under an oat crumble.
- [Pecan pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/pecan-pie/): Pecans in a caramel custard filling.
- [Maple taffy on snow](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/maple-taffy-on-snow/): Maple syrup boiled to soft-ball stage and poured on clean snow.
- [Mulberry galette](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/mulberry-galette/): Mulberries in a free-form buttery tart.
- [Wild strawberry shortcake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/us/dishes/wild-strawberry-shortcake/): Tiny wild strawberries over biscuits with whipped cream.
